articleTitle: Apify Homepage Teardown: Jan 2020 to Jun 2026
h1: How Apify rewrote its homepage over 6 years

analysis-blocks.label: Jan 2020 — original state
analysis-blocks.heading: The original: product-led messaging
annotations: H1 opens with: "Extract data from any website" — direct product statement.
Visible section headings include: "Turn any website into an API", "How can Apifyhelp your business?", "Products".
Navigation includes: "Free store", "Get quote" — product category framing.
Section headings later removed include: "Turn any website into an API" and "How can Apifyhelp your business?".

analysis-blocks.label: Apr 2022 — mid-transition
analysis-blocks.heading: Mid-period: signs of a structural shift
annotations: Visual similarity to the previous snapshot: 93.5% — a moderate visual change.
H1 in this snapshot: "The most powerful web scraping and automation platform".
New section headings appearing: "Hundreds of ready-to-use tools", "Use Apify for various use cases".
Changes across this period appear incremental rather than a single redesign event.

analysis-blocks.label: Jun 2026 — current state
analysis-blocks.heading: Today: updated positioning
annotations: H1 now reads: "39,044 tools for your AI" — updated value proposition.
New section headings include: "Not just a web scraping API", "Take your Actors beyond the open web", "Build and deploy reliable scrapers".
CTAs no longer present include: "Browse all actors".

messaging.note: This change can be read as a deliberate update to the primary value proposition frame. No confirmed strategy is implied.

messaging.before: Apify extracts data from websites, crawls lists of URLs and automates workflows on the web. Turn any website into an API in a few minutes!
messaging.after: Cloud platform for web scraping, browser automation, AI agents, and data for AI. Use 39,000+ ready-made tools, code templates, or order a custom solution.
messaging.note: Meta description updated. The change in framing may reflect a positioning adjustment or an SEO update.

messaging.before: Web Scraping, Data Extraction and Automation · Apify
messaging.after: Apify: Full-stack web scraping and data extraction platform

snapshots.above_fold_structure: Bold blue hero section with white headline 'Extract data from any website', subheading, and feature cards displaying product integrations below.
Colorful gradient hero with headline 'The most powerful web scraping and automation platform', statistics badges, and customer logos, followed by tool cards.
Minimal gradient hero with headline 'Build reliable web scrapers. Fast.' followed by customer logos and two-column content layout with code examples.
Subtle gradient hero with large headline '39,044 tools for your AI' and grid of tool cards with alternating layouts and code examples.
Error page displaying '429 Too Many Requests' message on plain white background with minimal styling.

visual-analysis.visual_shift_summary: The design evolved from bold blue solid backgrounds with prominent feature cards (2020) through gradient-heavy, colorful hero sections emphasizing social proof (2022), toward increasingly minimal and refined layouts with subtle gradients and content-forward design (2024). The current live state reflects a system error rather than production design.
